issues.description: Constructor parameter order for ExcellenceLand in the solution does not match the order required by the problem statement/UML. The problem specifies that constructors must take attributes in the same order as shown in the UML (excellencyLevel, then excellentEnough) and the tasks require an attribute 'rides' of type List<Ride>. The solution's constructor signature places 'rides' first and reverses the order of excellencyLevel and excellentEnough (List<Ride> rides, boolean excellentEnough, double excellencyLevel), which contradicts the specified parameter ordering and will confuse students and/or make automated constructor checks fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the ExcellenceLand constructor signature to accept attributes in the order specified by the UML/problem statement. For example: public ExcellenceLand(double excellencyLevel, boolean excellentEnough, List<Ride> rides) { ... } and assign the parameters to the corresponding fields. Ensure the getter names remain consistent with the attributes.
